messages:
maria: Quick sync  I'm converting the function-invoke page to SDK-first snippets + a clear structured-output section. Plan: minimal JSONSchema, full envelope example (incl. metadata), streaming + non-streaming snippets, and a short migration note.
aj (sdk): Sounds good. Include a 1-line helper for lenient vs strict parsing in JS/TS. Also prefer named params in examples.
samir (eng-ml): Make sure examples reflect runtime envelope: schema_version and metrics.request_latency_ms are present in real responses. Also add an example where payload is an array (many functions return lists).
maria: will add minimal schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"payload":{"type":"object"}},"required":["payload"]} and a full example showing metadata and metrics.
kai (devex): I can run anchor-scan after PR lands. Please list broken anchors in the PR body so my script can target them. I'll also prepare an automated snippet migrator to avoid manual edits across pages.
eva (qa): Add a docs-e2e test that uses the parser to validate the sample JSON. Current parser flags unknownProps=false, so full example must allow metadata or be marked example-only. I can add the test tomorrow.
link-bot: queued anchor-check for PR 1001 once opened.
maria: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1001 (WIP). Requesting reviews from @aj, @samir, @kai. Target: reviewers by EOW, merge after docs-e2e and link-check pass next week. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
